title: REVERSE POSITIONED-SUBJECT EMPIRICAL POSSIBILITY-FIELD COURT

target_capability.name: REVERSE_POSITIONED_SUBJECT_EMPIRICAL_POSSIBILITY_INFERENCE
target_capability.query_form: P(Q1,...,Qk | exact lawfully comparable generated-subject empirical properties, historical/source scope)
target_capability.definition: An uncertainty-bearing, historically/source-scoped empirical field over the complete joint response/disposition configurations requested by one authorized reverse query, selected by an exact empirical predicate derived from lawfully comparable generated-subject demographic/biographical facts.

query_identity.M: exact D12D-owned comparability mapping from generated facts to empirical predicate
query_identity.Omega_T: exact lawful target configuration space under governed response topology
query_identity.mu: declared raw and, where governed, weighted empirical measure basis

minimum_information_per_configuration: probability/mass only when the relevant denominator is positive
condition predicate identity and comparability provenance

candidate_information_targets.qualification: Sufficient for target arity 1; sufficient for higher arity only if exact mutual conditional independence is separately proven under identical conditioner/risk-set/scope/measure/topology/support semantics.
A complete 2-way contingency is sufficient for a 2-variable bounded target. All pairwise contingencies are not generally sufficient for k>2.
The exact conditional joint/support geometry at the requested target arity is information sufficient; universal eager materialization over all questions/properties is not required by D12E.

Only if exhaustive: every positive configuration retained, exact denominator known, omitted lawful cells explicitly observed-zero, no top-k/threshold/cardinality truncation, and topology/support/provenance exact.
Sufficient only if exact factorization/parameterization reconstructs the authorized full conditional joint and support/typed-state geometry without approximation.
Required at the future-selectable query frontier when conditioner conjunction, target subset/arity, risk set, or prior-response condition may be selected later.

Any representation is admissible in information terms if it exactly answers the authorized P(T|C,R,S) query including support and typed uncertainty without fabricating independence or deleting minorities.

independence_attack.lossless_condition: Exact mutual conditional independence/factorization must be positively established for every lawful target configuration under the same C,R,S,mu, topology and support semantics.

pairwise_attack.parity_theorem: For four binary variables, even-parity and odd-parity distributions can have identical unary, pairwise, and all three-way marginals while their four-way supports are disjoint.

support_uncertainty_law.uncertainty_rule: Preserve the design/method basis required by any authorized estimator; if unavailable, return typed unquantified uncertainty rather than fabricated confidence.

potential_conditioner_classes: prior response configuration where an explicit actor-to-survey response comparator exists

mandatory_cases.A: Unary age-conditioned target: exact unary contingency sufficient only after lawful actor-age -> empirical-age predicate mapping; REQUIRES_D12D_SEAM.
mandatory_cases.B: Several comparable properties: exact conjunction required; separate one-property marginals are insufficient.
mandatory_cases.C: Two-way joint attitudes: exact conditional Q1×Q2 contingency required unless exact conditional independence is proven.
mandatory_cases.D: Four-way target: exact 4-way joint or information-equivalent representation required.
mandatory_cases.E: Identical unary marginals can coexist with disjoint joint support; UNARY_INSUFFICIENT.
mandatory_cases.F: Parity/XOR: even all lower-order marginals can be identical while full k-way support differs; PAIRWISE_INSUFFICIENT.
mandatory_cases.G: Multimodal population: all supported modes must survive; modal/top-k summaries are lossy.
mandatory_cases.H: Contradictory supported configuration: preserve as empirical possibility without inferring actor contradiction.
mandatory_cases.I: Low-support minority: positive support and uncertainty must survive; low support is not impossibility.
mandatory_cases.J: Zero-support conditioner: conditional undefined/no empirical basis; no fallback distribution.
mandatory_cases.K: Sparse support: exhaustive sparse representation can be exact for a bounded query.
mandatory_cases.M: Different respondent universes: no false joint; separate fields or typed unavailable.
mandatory_cases.N: No survey comparator for actor property: REQUIRES_D12D_SEAM; no fuzzy fallback.
mandatory_cases.O: Historically distant survey: preserve time/source semantics and unresolved temporal comparability.
mandatory_cases.P: Same structural position but different comparable biographies can select different empirical fields; structural position equality does not collapse comparator predicates.

actor_metabolism_boundary.strongest_empirical_statement: Under exact comparator predicate C and historical/source scope S, target configuration z has the stated observed support/mass and uncertainty state under the exact risk-set and response topology.
actor_metabolism_boundary.strongest_subject_relative_statement_aft: The generated subject's exact comparable properties select empirical possibility field F as an upstream historical population prior/constraint.
direct_actor_assignment_forbidden: actor belief probability asserted as present psyche
actor_metabolism_boundary.later_requirement: A separately governed V3-side rule must admit/metabolize the field as one developmental constraint while preserving generated history, mediation, opportunity, encounter, exposure, relationships, response, memory and epistemic state as separate causal jurisdictions.

historical_profile_genealogy.surviving_valid_insight: Independent marginal draws can fabricate unsupported configurations and erase empirically supported joint configurations.
historical_profile_genealogy.rejected_shortcut: Respondent configuration determines what a generated actor already believes or who the actor is.

current_surface.reason: Pairwise/order-sensitive/modal-cell lossy composite with unresolved routing/topology/weighting limitations; not general k-way conditioned possibility field.
